g.text: Near the coincidence, gap and chord go to 0 continuously: linearly in general, quadratically for the chamfer at a box corner
(where its two zero lines, φ₁ = φ₂ and φ₁ + φ₂ = 180°, cross), so that escalate window is ~0.008°–0.26° rather than ~1e-4°.
